[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-95[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]`sase task`: durable, session-aware background tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every SASE background task is durably recorded, listable and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]inspectable from the CLI, attributed to the TUI session it came [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from, and launchable with `sase task run`; approving an epic runs [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]its `sase bead work` bead creation as one of these visible tasks [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of an invisible detached process.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]background_tasks.md[/bold #87AFFF]

    [#D7D7AF]retention-bounded background-task record store and its `sase_core_rs` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bindings in the sase-core repo.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]session chip shared by the CLI and TUI.[/#D7D7AF]
